Top Rotator Cuff Repair Surgery in Hyderabad: What To Expect

Dr. B Harsha Vardhana Reddy6 March 2026
Rotator Cuff Repair Surgery in Hyderabad

Introduction

The shoulder joint is one of the most flexible joints in the human body, allowing for a wide range of motion. This flexibility is largely due to the rotator cuff, a group of four muscles and their tendons that surround the shoulder joint. When these tendons are damaged or torn, it can lead to significant pain and limited mobility, prompting the need for rotator cuff repair surgery. For residents in Hyderabad seeking expert orthopedic care, Dr. B Harsha Vardhana Reddy at Apollo Hospitals, Financial District, Hyderabad, offers advanced surgical solutions for repairing the rotator cuff.

Understanding Rotator Cuff Injuries

Rotator cuff injuries are common among people who engage in repetitive overhead motions, such as athletes, painters, and certain manual laborers. These injuries can range from inflammation (tendinitis) to partial or complete tears of the tendons. Symptoms typically include shoulder pain, weakness, and a decreased range of motion. Without proper treatment, rotator cuff injuries can severely impact daily activities and quality of life.

Diagnosis and Imaging

  • Physical Examination: Initial assessment by Dr. Harsha might involve checking for pain, swelling, and tenderness around the shoulder area.
  • Imaging Studies: Diagnostic imaging such as X-rays, MRI, or ultrasound may be used to visualize the extent of the rotator cuff injury. These tools help in planning the appropriate surgical intervention if necessary.

Treatment Options

When it comes to treating a rotator cuff injury, the approach is typically tailored to the severity of the injury and the individual patient's needs. Non-surgical treatments might include physical therapy, corticosteroid injections, and anti-inflammatory medications. However, for more severe cases, rotator cuff repair surgery becomes necessary. During surgery, the torn tendon is reattached to the bone, which can be accomplished through minimally invasive techniques or open surgery, depending on the specific condition. Frequently Asked Questions

Q: What should I expect during rotator cuff repair surgery?

A: During the procedure, you'll be under anesthesia. The surgeon will make small incisions near the shoulder to access the torn tendon and repair it. The surgery may take one to two hours depending on the complexity.

Q: How long does recovery take after rotator cuff repair surgery?

A: Recovery varies, but patients typically require three to six months to regain full shoulder function. Rehabilitation exercises are a crucial part of recovery for restoring strength and mobility.
